pairs: Prævaricatus est autem Moab in Israël,
Then, after the death of Ahab,
Ceciditque Ochozias per cancellos cœnaculi sui,
And Ahaziah fell down through the lattices of his upper room,
consult Beelzebub, the god of Ekron,
utrum vivere queam de infirmitate mea hac.
as to whether I may be able to survive this infirmity of mine.”
Angelus autem Domini locutus est ad Eliam Thesbiten,
And an Angel of the Lord spoke to Elijah, the Tishbite,
et ascende in occursum nuntiorum regis Samariæ,
and ascend to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria.
et dices ad eos: Numquid non est Deus in Israël,
And you shall say to them: ‘Is there not a God in Israel,
ut eatis ad consulendum Beelzebub deum Accaron?
so that you would go to consult Beelzebub, the god of Ekron?
Quam ob rem hæc dicit Dominus:
For this reason, thus says the Lord:
From the bed to which you have ascended,
And the messengers returned to Ahaziah.
et revertimini ad regem qui misit vos, et dicetis ei:
and return to the king who sent you. And you shall say to him:
Numquid quia non erat Deus in Israël, mittis ut consulatur Beelzebub deus Accaron?
Is it because there was no God in Israel that you are sending to consult Beelzebub, the god of Ekron?
idcirco de lectulo, super quem ascendisti,
Therefore, from the bed to which you have ascended,
Cujus figuræ et habitus est vir ille,
“What was the appearance and dress of that man,
qui occurrit vobis, et locutus est verba hæc?
who met you and who spoke these words?”
with a belt of leather wrapping his waist.”
And he sent to him a leader of fifty,
et quinquaginta qui erant sub eo.
with the fifty who were under him.
sitting at the top of a hill,
the king commanded that you should descend.”
Elijah said to the leader of fifty,
“If I am a man of God,
And then fire from heaven descended
et quinquaginta qui erant cum eo.
and the fifty who were with him.
Rursumque misit ad eum principem quinquagenarium alterum,
And again, he sent to him another leader of fifty,
“If I am a man of God,
Iterum misit principem quinquagenarium tertium, et quinquaginta qui erant cum eo.
Again, he sent a third leader of fifty men and the fifty who were with him.
he bent his knees before Elijah,
noli despicere animam meam, et animas servorum tuorum qui mecum sunt.
do not choose to despise my life and the lives of your servants who are with me.
Ecce descendit ignis de cælo, et devoravit duos principes quinquagenarios primos, et quinquagenos qui cum eis erant: sed nunc obsecro ut miserearis animæ meæ.
Behold, fire from heaven descended and devoured the two previous leaders of fifty and the fifties who were with them. But now I beg you to take pity on my life.”
Locutus est autem angelus Domini ad Eliam,
Then the Angel of the Lord spoke to Elijah,
et descendit cum eo ad regem,
he arose and descended with him to the king.
Quia misisti nuntios ad consulendum Beelzebub deum Accaron,
Because you sent messengers to consult Beelzebub, the god of Ekron,
quasi non esset Deus in Israël a quo posses interrogare sermonem,
as if there were no God in Israel, from whom you would be able to seek a word,
ideo de lectulo super quem ascendisti,
therefore, from the bed to which you have ascended,
Mortuus est ergo juxta sermonem Domini quem locutus est Elias,
And so he died, in accord with the word of the Lord, which Elijah spoke.
et regnavit Joram frater ejus pro eo,
And Jehoram, his brother, reigned in his place,
anno secundo Joram filii Josaphat regis Judæ:
in the second year of Jehoram, the son of Jehoshaphat,
the king of Judah. For he had no son.
Reliqua autem verborum Ochoziæ quæ operatus est,
But the rest of the words of Ahaziah that he worked,
nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro sermonum dierum regum Israël?
have these not been written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Israel?
